title: DILATE A LABEL FILE
description: Fills in label information for all vertices designated as bad, up to the specified distance away from other labels.  If -bad-vertex-roi is specified, all vertices, including those with the unlabeled key, are good, except for vertices with a positive value in the ROI.  If it is not specified, only vertices with the unlabeled key are bad.

dilate_dist.description: distance in mm to dilate the labels

bad_vertex_roi.description: specify an roi of vertices to overwrite, rather than vertices with the unlabeled key

column.description: select a single column to dilate

corrected_areas.description: vertex areas to use instead of computing them from the surface
